## Abstract {.unnumbered}

From an open objective about ALS/C9orf72, the system moves through evidence, mechanism, competing
hypotheses, candidate intervention, adversarial review and falsification experiments to a final research
proposal. Every material claim is traceable to an evidence identifier and, from there, to a source or a
reproducible computational result. It is a research system, not clinical decision support, and a run may
validly conclude that the evidence is insufficient.
